source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 12 (PDF 261-279), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the structure of the atomic nucleus. Define atomic number, mass number and neutron number and give the relation between them. What are isotopes? Define the unified mass unit. (5 marks)
(Atomi nucleus ki saakht bayan karein. Atomic number, mass number aur neutron number ki definitions aur un ka ta'alluq likhein. Isotopes kya hain? Unified mass unit ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ajza: Nucleus do qisam ke particles, protons aur neutrons, par mushtamil hai; dono ko nucleons kehte hain.
Proton: sab se saade atom hydrogen (protium) ka nucleus; charge +1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C (electron ke barabar magnitude); mass 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg.
Neutron: 1932 mein James Chadwick ne nishandahi ki; charge nahi; mass taqreeban proton ke barabar.
Hydrogen ka nucleus sirf aik proton hai; baqi tamam nuclei mein dono hote hain. Mukhtalif nuclei ko nuclides kehte hain.

Atomic number Z: nucleus mein protons ki tadaad.
Mass number A: nucleons (neutrons + protons) ki kul tadaad.
Neutron number N:
N = A − Z ... (12.1)
Nucleus ko ᴬ_Z X likhte hain, jahan X element ki chemical alamat hai.

Isotopes: woh nuclei jin mein protons barabar magar neutrons mukhtalif hon. Carbon mein hamesha 6 protons magar 6, 7 ya 8 neutrons: ¹²₆C, ¹³₆C, ¹⁴₆C. ¹²₆C aur ¹³₆C stable; ¹⁴₆C unstable hai aur β aur neutrino de kar nitrogen ban jata hai.

Unified mass unit: 1 u carbon-12 atom ke mass ka theek 1/12 hissa hai.
1 u = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 931 MeV
Is unit mein: proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, electron 0.00055 u.

book_ref.quote: The atomic nucleus comprises two types of particles: protons and neutrons.

blocks.prompt:
2 An iron nucleus is ⁵⁶₂₆Fe. Find (i) its number of neutrons (ii) the total mass of its protons and neutrons taken separately, in u and in kg (iii) the energy equivalent of this mass in MeV. (Proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, 1 u = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 931 MeV) (3 marks)
(Iron ka nucleus ⁵⁶₂₆Fe hai. Nikalein: (i) neutrons ki tadaad (ii) us ke protons aur neutrons ka alag alag liya gaya kul mass, u aur kg mein (iii) is mass ki energy MeV mein. (Proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, 1 u = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 931 MeV))
blocks.explanation: N = A − Z lagayein, phir Z protons aur N neutrons ke mass jama karein; 1 u ki qeematon se badlein.

book_ref.quote: In this unit the mass of a proton is 1.007276 u and that of a neutron is 1.008665 u

blocks.final_answer: N = 30; mass = 56.449 u = 9.37 × 10⁻²⁶ kg; energy = 5.26 × 10⁴ MeV

blocks.prompt:
3 What are the fundamental forces of nature? Describe each of the four fundamental forces and compare their relative strength and range. (5 marks)
(Qudrat ki bunyadi forces kya hain? Chaaron bunyadi forces ko bayan karein aur un ki nisbati taaqat aur range ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kainaat ke tamam ta'amulat chaar bunyadi forces ke tabe hain. Yeh atoms se kahkashaon tak ajsaam ki harkat aur ta'amul control karti hain.

(i) Gravitational force: chaaron mein sab se kamzor magar long-range; hamesha kashish wali. Do ajsaam ke darmiyan force un ke masses ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib aur faasle ke murabba ke ulat mutanasib hai. Sooraj aur bade sayyaron ke liye ahem, atomi satah par na-qabil-e-zikr.

(ii) Electromagnetic force: electric aur magnetic field ke ta'amulat ki zimmedar. Gravity ki tarah inverse square law maanti hai magar kahin taaqatwar hai. Atom ki saakht, chemical bonding, bijli, magnetism aur roshni ko control karti hai. Maxwell (1861) ne chaar equations se bijli aur magnetism ko aik force ke do pehlu sabit kiya.

(iii) Strong nuclear force: sab se taaqatwar kashish wali force. Sirf gravity aur electromagnetism se nucleus bikhar jata; us ki stability is force ki daleel hai. Yeh nuclei ko jode rakhti hai, sirf nucleus ke andar hai (short-range) aur tamam nucleons ko yaksaan kheenchti hai; protons is se kheenchte aur electric force se dhakelte hain; neutrons is se doosre nucleons ko kheenchte hain.

(iv) Weak nuclear force: radioactive decay, khaas kar beta decay, aur neutrino wale ta'amulat ki zimmedar. Particles ki pehchaan badal sakti hai, is liye sitaron mein fusion ke liye zaroori hai.

Muqabla (Table 12.1):

book_ref.quote: all interactions in the universe are governed by the four basic forces known as fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
4 Using the relative strengths in Table 12.1, find how many times (i) the strong force is stronger than the weak force (ii) the electromagnetic force is stronger than gravity (iii) the weak force is stronger than gravity. (3 marks)
(Table 12.1 ki nisbati taaqat se nikalein ke kitne guna: (i) strong force weak force se taaqatwar hai (ii) electromagnetic force gravity se taaqatwar hai (iii) weak force gravity se taaqatwar hai.)
blocks.explanation: Har nisbat aik nisbati taaqat ko doosri se taqseem karna hai; 10 ki powers ki taqseem mein exponents minus karein.

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Relative strength and range of four fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
5 What are anti-particles? Explain the process of pair production. Why is a nucleus necessary for it, and what is the minimum photon energy required? (5 marks)
(Anti-particles kya hain? Pair production ka amal bayan karein. Is ke liye nucleus kyun zaroori hai aur photon ki kam se kam energy kitni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation:
Anti-particles: Paul Dirac ne 1928 mein peshgoi ki ke bunyadi particles ke anti-particles hote hain. Anti-particle ka rest mass apne particle ke barabar magar charge ulta hota hai. Positron e⁺ electron ka anti-particle hai: wahi rest mass, wahi magnitude ka positive charge. Yeh pehla daryaft hone wala anti-particle tha (Anderson, 1932, cloud chamber). Anti-particles bar se likhe jate hain, maslan p̄, ν̄. Antiproton 1955 mein Segre aur Chamberlain ne particle accelerator se daryaft kiya.

Pair production: Jab gamma ray photon (high-energy photon) atomi nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai to ghaib ho kar electron-positron jora bana deta hai (Fig. 12.1):
γ → e⁻ + e⁺ (nucleus ke qareeb)

Nucleus ka kirdar: Teesra particle, maslan nucleus, jo takkar mein recoil karta hai, linear momentum aur energy dono ko aik saath conserve rakhne ke liye zaroori hai. Is liye pair production khala (vacuum) mein nahi hoti.

Kam se kam energy: Mass-energy equivalence se photon ki kam se kam energy bane particles ki rest mass energies ke majmooe ke barabar hai:
Emin = 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV
1.02 MeV se kam energy wala photon jora nahi bana sakta; zyada ho to zaaid energy particles ki kinetic energy ban jati hai:
Ephoton = 1.02 MeV + K.E.(e⁻) + K.E.(e⁺)

Pair production charge (0 = −e + e), momentum aur energy ke conservation ko poora karti hai.

book_ref.quote: According to the law of mass-energy equivalence, the minimum energy of a photon for pair production

blocks.prompt:
6 A gamma photon of energy 2.50 MeV produces an electron-positron pair near a nucleus. Find (i) the total kinetic energy of the pair (ii) the kinetic energy of each particle if shared equally (iii) the total kinetic energy in joules. (1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J) (3 marks)
(2.50 MeV ka gamma photon nucleus ke qareeb electron-positron jora banata hai. Nikalein: (i) jore ki kul kinetic energy (ii) barabar bante to har particle ki kinetic energy (iii) kul kinetic energy joules mein. (1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J))
blocks.explanation: Photon ki energy se jore ki rest mass energy 1.02 MeV minus karein; baqi kinetic energy hai.

book_ref.quote: the excess energy goes into the kinetic energies of the particles

steps: Jore ki rest mass energy = 1.02 MeV

blocks.prompt:
7 What is annihilation of matter? Explain the annihilation of an electron and a positron, showing how energy and momentum are conserved. Give other examples of annihilation. (5 marks)
(Annihilation of matter kya hai? Electron aur positron ka annihilation bayan karein aur dikhayein ke energy aur momentum kaise conserve hote hain. Annihilation ki doosri misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Annihilation pair production ka ulat amal hai: particle aur us ka anti-particle milte hain aur un ka mass energy ban jata hai.

Electron-positron annihilation: Jab electron aur positron milte hain to do gamma ray photons ban jate hain (Fig. 12.2):
e⁻ + e⁺ → γ + γ

Energy: Saakin electron aur positron ki kul rest mass energy 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV hai. Yeh do photons ki shakal mein aati hai, har aik ki energy
E = m₀c² = 0.51 MeV
jo electron ya positron ki rest mass energy ke barabar hai.

Momentum: Saakin jore ka kul momentum sifr hai. Do photons energy barabar baant'te hain aur mukhalif simton mein jate hain, is liye un ka kul momentum bhi sifr hai. Yun annihilation mein energy aur momentum conserve rehte hain. Charge bhi: −e + e = 0.

Doosri misalein: doosre particles ka apne anti-particles ke saath annihilation, maslan proton aur antiproton, lepton aur antilepton, quark aur antiquark.

CERN mein high-energy takkaron se pata chala ke takraane wale particles ka kuch mass Einstein ki equation ke mutabiq electromagnetic radiation ban jata hai aur baqi mass naye sub-atomic particles ki shakal mein aata hai.

book_ref.quote: when an electron and a positron interact to each other they annihilate into two gamma ray photons

blocks.prompt:
8 An electron and a positron, both at rest, annihilate. Taking the electron's mass as 0.00055 u and 1 u = 931 MeV, find (i) the energy of each gamma photon (ii) the total energy released in MeV and in joules. (1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J) (3 marks)
(Saakin electron aur positron annihilate hote hain. Electron ka mass 0.00055 u aur 1 u = 931 MeV le kar nikalein: (i) har gamma photon ki energy (ii) kul energy MeV aur joules mein. (1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J))
blocks.explanation: Har photon aik particle ki rest mass energy le jata hai (positron ka mass electron ke barabar); kul ke liye dono jama karein.

book_ref.quote: In an annihilation reaction energy and momentum are conserved.

steps: Aik electron ki rest mass energy: 0.00055 × 931 = 0.512 MeV

blocks.prompt:
9 What is radioactivity? Distinguish natural and artificial radioactivity. Describe how α, β and γ radiations behave in an electric field and what this shows about them. (5 marks)
(Radioactivity kya hai? Natural aur artificial radioactivity mein farq karein. Electric field mein α, β aur γ radiations ka rawayya aur us se un ke baare mein kya pata chalta hai, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Radioactivity: Atomic number 82 se zyada wale nuclei qudrati taur par unstable hain aur khud ba khud radiations khaarij karte hain. Aise nuclei radioactive hain aur yeh amal natural radioactivity hai. Radiations teen qisam ki hain: α-particles, β-particles aur γ-radiations.

Artificial radioactivity: Lab mein nuclear reactions se unstable isotopes banaye ja sakte hain, jab stable element par neutrons, protons, α-particles ya γ-rays jaise high-energy particles barsaye jayen. Aise radioactive isotopes radioisotopes ya radionuclides kehlate hain.

Electric field mein rawayya (Fig. 12.4):
α-particles: negative terminal ki taraf mudte hain, is liye positive hain. Roshni ki raftaar ke chand feesad se nikalte hain magar bhaari mass ki wajah se hawa mein sirf chand centimetre chalte hain.
β-particles: positive terminal ki taraf mudte hain, is liye negative hain. In ka deflection α se zyada hai, is liye halke hain. Yeh tez electrons hain jin ki raftaar roshni ki raftaar ke 0.9995 tak hai.
γ-radiations: baghair mude guzar jati hain, is liye charge nahi. Yeh electromagnetic radiations (photons) hain jo roshni ki raftaar se chalti hain; penetrating power sab se zyada, ionization power sab se kam.

Nucleus se α, β aur γ ka nikalna tarteeb-waar α-decay, β-decay aur γ-decay kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: These radiations are of three types, α-particles, β-particles and γ-radiations.

blocks.prompt:
10 Using the typical ionization values of Table 12.2 (α about 10⁴ and β about 10² ion pairs per mm of air), find the number of ion pairs produced by (i) an α-particle travelling 3.5 cm in air (ii) a β-particle travelling 2.0 m in air. (iii) How many times more ion pairs per mm does the α-particle produce? (3 marks)
(Table 12.2 ki aam ionization qeematon (α taqreeban 10⁴ aur β taqreeban 10² ion pairs fi mm hawa) se nikalein: (i) hawa mein 3.5 cm chalne wala α-particle kitne ion pairs banata hai (ii) hawa mein 2.0 m chalne wala β-particle kitne (iii) α fi mm kitne guna zyada ion pairs banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har raaste ko mm mein badlein aur fi mm ion pairs se zarb dein; (iii) ke liye fi mm qeematon ki nisbat lein.

book_ref.quote: Table 12.2: The summary of nature of alpha, beta and gamma radiations

blocks.prompt:
11 What is α-decay? Write its general equation and explain the changes in the parent nucleus with an example. What is meant by transmutation and by the disintegration energy (Q-value)? (5 marks)
(α-decay kya hai? Is ki aam equation likhein aur misaal ke saath parent nucleus ki tabdeeliyan bayan karein. Transmutation aur disintegration energy (Q-value) se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Wajah: Bhaari nucleus mein us ke bohat se protons ki electric repulsion poore nucleus mein amal karti hai, jabke strong nuclear force sirf qareebi nucleons ke darmiyan hai. Nucleus unstable ho kar α-particle khaarij karta hai.

α-particle: helium nucleus ke barabar, do protons aur do neutrons. Nucleus do protons aur do neutrons kho deta hai, is liye Z do aur A chaar kam ho jata hai:
ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ⁻⁴_(Z−2) Y + ⁴₂He ... (12.2)
ᴬ_Z X parent nucleus, ᴬ⁻⁴_(Z−2) Y daughter nucleus aur ⁴₂He α-particle hai. Tajurbe se nucleons ki tadaad A aur electric charge conserve rehte hain.

Misaal: radium-226 α-particle de kar radon-222 ban jata hai:
²²⁶₈₈Ra → ²²²₈₆Rn + ⁴₂He ... (12.3)
Jaanch: A: 226 = 222 + 4; Z: 88 = 86 + 2.

Transmutation: daughter (Rn) parent (Ra) se mukhtalif element hai. Aik element ka doosre mein badalna transmutation of elements hai.

Q-value: Parent nucleus ka mass daughter aur α-particle ke kul mass se zyada hai. Is liye products ki kul mass-energy (E = mc²) asal nuclide se kam hai. Mass-energy ka yeh farq disintegration energy Q hai:
Q = (m_parent − m_daughter − m_α)c²

book_ref.quote: Alpha decay can be written in general as

blocks.prompt:
12 Polonium-210 (²¹⁰₈₄Po) is an α-emitter. Find (i) A and Z of the daughter nucleus (ii) the disintegration energy Q in MeV and in joules. (Masses: ²¹⁰Po = 209.982874 u, daughter = 205.974465 u, ⁴He = 4.002603 u; 1 u = 931 MeV; 1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J) (3 marks)
(Polonium-210 (²¹⁰₈₄Po) α khaarij karta hai. Nikalein: (i) daughter nucleus ka A aur Z (ii) disintegration energy Q, MeV aur joules mein. (Mass: ²¹⁰Po = 209.982874 u, daughter = 205.974465 u, ⁴He = 4.002603 u; 1 u = 931 MeV; 1 MeV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J))
blocks.explanation: α-decay mein A 4 aur Z 2 kam hota hai; Q = khoya hua mass (parent minus products) × 931 MeV/u.

book_ref.quote: Thus the total mass-energy (E = mc²) of the decay products is less than the mass-energy of the original nuclide.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain β⁻-decay and β⁺-decay. Write the decay of the nucleon and the general equation in each case, with an example. Why was the neutrino proposed? (5 marks)
(β⁻-decay aur β⁺-decay bayan karein. Har soorat mein nucleon ka decay aur aam equation misaal ke saath likhein. Neutrino ka khayal kyun pesh kiya gaya?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) β⁻-decay: Jin nuclides ki neutron-to-proton ratio (N/P) bohat zyada ho woh β⁻-decay karte hain. β-particles orbital electrons nahi; yeh khaarij hone ke lamhe nucleus ke andar bante hain. Neutron proton, electron aur antineutrino mein badalta hai:
¹₀n → ¹₁p + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄
Charge conserve rakhne ke liye electron nikalta hai. Koi nucleon kam nahi hota, is liye A wahi rehta hai aur atomic number Z aik barh jata hai:
ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z+1) Y + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄
Misaal: thorium-234 protactinium ban jata hai: ²³⁴₉₀Th → ²³⁴₉₁Pa + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄

(ii) β⁺-decay: Jin nuclides ki N/P stability ke liye bohat kam ho woh positron khaarij karte hain (mass electron jitna, charge positive; electron ka anti-particle). Proton neutron, positron aur neutrino mein badalta hai; Z aik kam, A wahi:
ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z−1) Y + ⁰₊₁e + ν
Misaal: ¹⁹₁₀Ne → ¹⁹₉F + ⁰₊₁e + ν

Neutrino: Wolfgang Pauli ne 1930 mein pesh kiya taake β⁻ aur β⁺ decay mein energy conserve rahe. Neutrino aur antineutrino ka charge sifr aur mass bohat kam hai, is liye dekhna mushkil hai; 1953 mein F. Reines aur C. L. Cowan ne high-power nuclear reactor mein detect kiya.

book_ref.quote: There are two types of β-decay, beta-minus decay and beta-plus decay.

blocks.prompt:
14 A free neutron decays as n → p + e⁻ + ν̄. Using the masses given in the chapter (neutron 1.008665 u, proton 1.007276 u, electron 0.00055 u) and 1 u = 931 MeV, find the energy released. Treat the antineutrino's mass as negligible. (3 marks)
(Azad neutron n → p + e⁻ + ν̄ ki tarah decay hota hai. Chapter ke mass (neutron 1.008665 u, proton 1.007276 u, electron 0.00055 u) aur 1 u = 931 MeV se kharij hone wali energy nikalein. Antineutrino ka mass na-qabil-e-zikr samjhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kharij energy = khoya hua mass (neutron minus proton aur electron) × 931 MeV/u.

book_ref.quote: In this process, a neutron in the nucleus decays into a proton and an electron

blocks.final_answer: Kharij energy = 0.781 MeV (electron aur antineutrino mein bat'ti hai)

blocks.prompt:
15 Compare the energy spectra of α-particles and β-particles emitted by a radionuclide. Explain γ-emission and summarise the properties of α, β and γ radiations. (5 marks)
(Kisi radionuclide se nikalne wale α aur β particles ke energy spectra ka muqabla karein. γ-emission bayan karein aur α, β aur γ ki khususiyaat ka khulasa dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kisi khaas radionuclide ke α-decay aur β-decay mein har baar utni hi energy niklti hai.

α-spectrum: har α-particle ki kinetic energy aik hi aur mukarrar hoti hai. α-particles ki tadaad aur kinetic energy ke graph mein waazeh spikes hain (Fig. 12.5): α-particles ki energies discrete hain.

β-spectrum: energy β-particle aur antineutrino (ya neutrino) mein mukhtalif hisson mein bat'ti hai, magar majmua hamesha wahi rehta hai. Is liye electron ya positron ki energy sifr se zyada se zyada qeemat tak ho sakti hai. Graph aik hamwar curve hai (Fig. 12.6): β-particles ki energies musalsal (continuous) hain.
α aur β dono mein momentum aur energy ka conservation laagu hai.

γ-emission: Excited nucleus γ-radiation de kar ground state mein aata hai:
ᴬ_Z X* → ᴬ_Z X + γ
A aur Z nahi badalte.

Khulasa (Table 12.2):

book_ref.quote: In both α-decay and β-decay, for a particular radionuclide, the same amount of energy is released.

rows: Nucleus se electrons ya positrons, charge ±e
Excited nuclei se E.M. waves, charge nahi
Hawa mein fi mm ion pairs

blocks.prompt:
16 In a certain β⁻-decay, 1.71 MeV is shared between the electron and the antineutrino. Find (i) the electron's energy when the antineutrino carries 0.96 MeV (ii) the antineutrino's energy when the electron carries 0.40 MeV (iii) the maximum possible energy of the electron. (3 marks)
(Aik β⁻-decay mein 1.71 MeV electron aur antineutrino mein bat'ti hai. Nikalein: (i) jab antineutrino 0.96 MeV le to electron ki energy (ii) jab electron 0.40 MeV le to antineutrino ki energy (iii) electron ki zyada se zyada mumkina energy.)
blocks.explanation: Dono energies ka majmua hamesha 1.71 MeV hai; electron ki energy zyada se zyada tab hai jab antineutrino ko taqreeban kuch na mile.

book_ref.quote: Thus in β-decay, the energy of an electron or a positron may range from zero to a maximum value.

blocks.prompt:
17 What is a fundamental particle? Explain the classification of particles into fermions and bosons, and into hadrons (baryons and mesons) and leptons, with examples. (5 marks)
(Fundamental particle kya hai? Particles ki fermions aur bosons, aur hadrons (baryons aur mesons) aur leptons mein taqseem misalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fundamental particle: jis ki koi androoni saakht na ho, yani na-qabil-e-taqseem. Is waqt quarks (jin se protons, neutrons aur mesons bante hain) aur leptons (electrons, positrons, neutrinos) maadde ke bunyadi ajza hain. β-decay, jis mein neutron aur proton aik doosre mein badalte hain, saboot hai ke protons aur neutrons fundamental nahi.

Spin ke lehaaz se: Tamam particles apne mehwar par ghoomte hain. Electron, proton aur neutron ka spin 1/2, photon ka 1 aur pion ka 0 hai.
Fermions: aadhe spin wale; Pauli's exclusion principle maante hain (aik qisam ka sirf aik particle aik quantum state mein).
Bosons: sifr ya poore spin wale; yeh usool nahi maante, Bose-Einstein statistics maante hain.

Strong force ke lehaaz se:
Hadrons: strong force mehsoos karne wale murakkab particles, maslan protons, neutrons, pions. Do qismein:
  Baryons: fermions, taaq tadaad ke quarks (aam taur par teen), maslan proton, neutron, Λ⁰.
  Mesons: bosons, juft tadaad ke quarks (aam taur par aik quark aur aik antiquark), maslan pion, kaon.
Leptons: strong force mehsoos nahi karte; sirf weak ya electromagnetic interactions. Koi androoni saakht nahi mili; sab ka spin ½ (fermions). Chhe leptons teen jore: (e⁻, νₑ), (μ⁻, ν_μ), (τ⁻, ν_τ), har aik ka anti-particle bhi. Sab se maroof lepton electron hai; neutrinos bohat kam ta'amul karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Particles can be broadly classified based on whether they interact via the strong force.

blocks.prompt:
18 Using Table 12.3 (electron 0.511, muon 105.7, tau 1777 MeV/c²) and 1 u = 931 MeV, find (i) the muon's mass in u (ii) how many times heavier the muon is than the electron (iii) how many times heavier the tau is than the muon. (3 marks)
(Table 12.3 (electron 0.511, muon 105.7, tau 1777 MeV/c²) aur 1 u = 931 MeV se nikalein: (i) muon ka mass u mein (ii) muon electron se kitne guna bhaari hai (iii) tau muon se kitne guna bhaari hai.)
blocks.explanation: MeV/c² ko 931 se taqseem kar ke u milta hai; masses ki nisbat ke liye badalne ki zaroorat nahi.

book_ref.quote: Table 12.3: The lepton family

blocks.prompt:
19 What are quarks? Name the six quark flavours with their charges. Describe the proton, the neutron and the π⁺ meson in terms of quarks, explain β⁻-decay at the quark level, and explain colour charge. (5 marks)
(Quarks kya hain? Chhe quark flavours un ke charges ke saath likhein. Proton, neutron aur π⁺ meson ko quarks ki shakal mein bayan karein, β⁻-decay ko quark ki satah par samjhayein aur colour charge bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Quarks: 1964 mein M. Gell-Mann aur George Zweig ne kaha ke hadrons, protons aur neutrons bhi, mazeed bunyadi ajza quarks se bane hain. Quarks leptons ki tarah haqeeqi fundamental hain. In ka spin aur fractional charge hai, aur yeh kabhi akele zahir nahi hote.

Flavours (Table 12.4): up u (+2/3), down d (−1/3), strange s (−1/3) pehle pesh hue; charm c (+2/3), bottom b (−1/3), top t (+2/3) baad mein. Har antiquark ka charge ulta hai (ū −2/3, d̄ +1/3, ...).

Baryons mein teen quarks:
Proton (uud): q = 2/3 + 2/3 + (−1/3) = +1
Neutron (udd): q = 2/3 + (−1/3) + (−1/3) = 0
Mesons quark-antiquark jore hain:
π⁺ (ud̄): q = 2/3 + 1/3 = +1

Quarks mein β⁻-decay: n → p + e⁻ + ν̄. Neutron (udd) proton (uud) ban jata hai jab aik down quark up quark mein badalta hai:
d → u + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄

Colour: Quarks ki aik aur khoobi colour charge hai (electric charge ki tarah). Har flavour teen colours mein se aik: red, green, blue; antiquarks antired, antigreen, antiblue. Baryon mein har colour ka aik quark aur meson mein aik colour aur us ka anticolour, is liye dono be-rang (white). Colour charges ke darmiyan strong force colour force hai; is ki theory quantum chromodynamics (QCD) hai. Hadrons ke darmiyan strong force un ke quarks ki force hai.

book_ref.quote: All hadrons are considered to be made up of combinations of quarks

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka asaan tareeqa: up-type quarks (u, c, t) ka charge +2/3 aur down-type (d, s, b) ka −1/3. Kisi particle ka charge nikalne ke liye us ke quarks ke charge jama karein; antiquark ka charge ulta lein.

blocks.prompt:
20 Using the quark charges of Table 12.4, find the charge of each combination and say whether it is a baryon or a meson: (i) uss (ii) dū (iii) cd̄ (iv) ddd. (3 marks)
(Table 12.4 ke quark charges se har tarkeeb ka charge nikalein aur batayein ke baryon hai ya meson: (i) uss (ii) dū (iii) cd̄ (iv) ddd.)
blocks.explanation: Quarks ke charges jama karein (antiquark ka charge ulta); teen quarks baryon, quark-antiquark jora meson.

book_ref.quote: Mesons are quark–antiquark pairs.

blocks.prompt:
21 How do fundamental particles interact by exchanging bosons? Name the carriers of the fundamental forces. Describe the Higgs boson and its role in giving mass to particles. (5 marks)
(Bunyadi particles bosons ke tabadle se kaise ta'amul karte hain? Bunyadi forces ke carriers ke naam likhein. Higgs boson aur particles ko mass dene mein is ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bunyadi particles: chhe quarks, chhe leptons aur woh bosons jo bunyadi forces le jate hain.

Bosons ka tabadla: Leptons aur quarks bosons bhej aur le kar ta'amul karte hain; bosons force 'uthate' hain:
Electromagnetic force: do charged particles photons ka tabadla karte hain.
Strong force: nucleus mein do quarks gluons ke tabadle se kheenchte hain.
Weak nuclear force: W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons.
Gravitational force: gravitons.

Higgs boson: aik khaas particle jo 2012 mein CERN ke large hadron collider mein daryaft hua. Yeh Higgs field se juda hai jo poori khala mein phaila hai. Yeh mass se juda alag fundamental boson hai, kisi force ka carrier nahi.

Mass mein kirdar: Particles Higgs field se ta'amul kar ke mass paate hain. Zyada ta'amul wale zyada mass paate hain, maslan electroweak interaction ke carriers W⁺, W⁻ aur Z; photons ta'amul nahi karte, is liye un ka rest mass sifr hai.

Ahem baatein: mass taqreeban 125 GeV; jaldi doosre particles mein toot jata hai; apna mass Higgs field se ta'amul se leta hai; Big Bang ke foran baad kainaat ke halaat aur dark matter ki nishaniyon ka anokha darwaza ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Leptons and quarks interact with each other by sending and receiving bosons.

blocks.prompt:
22 The Higgs boson has a mass of about 125 GeV. Express it (i) in u (ii) in kg, and (iii) compare it with the proton's mass of 1.007276 u. (1 u = 931 MeV = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg) (3 marks)
(Higgs boson ka mass taqreeban 125 GeV hai. Ise (i) u mein (ii) kg mein likhein aur (iii) proton ke mass 1.007276 u se muqabla karein. (1 u = 931 MeV = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg))
blocks.explanation: GeV ko MeV mein badlein, u ke liye 931 se taqseem karein, kg ke liye 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ se zarb dein, phir proton ke mass se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: Higgs boson has a mass of around 125 giga-electron-volts (GeV)

blocks.final_answer: (i) 134 u (ii) 2.23 × 10⁻²⁵ kg (iii) proton ke mass ka taqreeban 133 guna

blocks.prompt:
23 State the conservation laws obeyed by all nuclear reactions and decays. Show with examples of α-decay, β⁻-decay and pair production that charge and nucleon number are conserved, and classify hadrons and non-hadrons. (5 marks)
(Tamam nuclear reactions aur decays jin conservation laws ko maante hain, bayan karein. α-decay, β⁻-decay aur pair production ki misalon se dikhayein ke charge aur nucleon number conserve rehte hain, aur hadrons aur non-hadrons ki taqseem bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tamam nuclear processes, maslan nuclear reactions aur decays, conservation laws maante hain:
(i) energy, momentum aur charge ka conservation, nucleon number A aur charge number Z samet;
(ii) baryon number ka conservation;
(iii) lepton number ka conservation.

α-decay: ²²⁶₈₈Ra → ²²²₈₆Rn + ⁴₂He
A: 226 = 222 + 4; Z: 88 = 86 + 2. Dono conserve; mass-energy ka farq Q-value ban jata hai, is liye energy conserve hai.

β⁻-decay: ¹₀n → ¹₁p + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄
A: 1 = 1 + 0; charge: 0 = +1 + (−1) + 0. Charge conserve rakhne ke liye electron nikalta hai aur antineutrino energy ka hissa le jata hai taake energy conserve rahe.

Pair production: γ → e⁻ + e⁺ (nucleus ke qareeb)
Charge: 0 = −1 + 1. Recoil karta nucleus momentum aur energy dono ko aik saath conserve rakhta hai.

Taqseem (chapter ka box):
Hadrons: mesons (maslan pions, kaons) aur baryons (maslan protons, neutrons, omega, sigma aur lambda particles).
Non-hadrons: leptons (electrons, muons, neutrinos), photons aur gravitons.

blocks.prompt:
24 Thorium-232 (²³²₉₀Th) decays through a series of α and β⁻ emissions into lead-208 (²⁰⁸₈₂Pb). Using conservation of nucleon number and charge number, find the number of α-particles and of β⁻-particles emitted. (3 marks)
(Thorium-232 (²³²₉₀Th) α aur β⁻ ke silsile se lead-208 (²⁰⁸₈₂Pb) mein badalta hai. Nucleon number aur charge number ke conservation se khaarij hone wale α-particles aur β⁻-particles ki tadaad nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf α-decay A badalta hai (har baar 4); A ki tabdeeli se α gin lein, phir Z se β⁻ ki tadaad nikalein (har β⁻ Z ko 1 barhata hai).

book_ref.quote: conservation of energy, momentum and charge.

steps: A ki tabdeeli = 232 − 208 = 24; har α 4 nucleons kam karta hai, β⁻ koi nahi
Har β⁻ Z ko 1 barhata hai: β⁻ ki tadaad = 82 − 78 = 4

blocks.prompt:
25 Explain the asymmetry of matter and antimatter in the universe and the suggested reason for it. What are dark matter and dark energy, and why is most of the matter in the observable universe said to be plasma? (5 marks)
(Kainaat mein matter aur antimatter ki asymmetry aur is ki mumkina wajah bayan karein. Dark matter aur dark energy kya hain, aur kyun kaha jata hai ke qabil-e-mushahida kainaat ka zyada tar maadda plasma hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Asymmetry: Bohat se mushahidaat matter aur antimatter ke darmiyan asymmetry dikhate hain; yeh hamari kainaat ki sab se ajeeb khoobiyon mein se hai. Kainaat taqreeban poori maadde par hai, antimatter par nahi: is ka aam maadda (electrons, protons, neutrons) zyada tar hydrogen aur helium atoms hai, antihydrogen ya anti-helium ka koi hissa nahi.

Mumkina wajah: Tajurbaat asymmetry ko baryon number ke conservation ki khilaaf-warzi se jodte hain, yani baryons aur anti-baryons ki tadaad mein adam-e-tawazun. Agar particle-antiparticle symmetry bhi toote to antiquarks se zyada quarks, antileptons se zyada leptons aur aakhir mein antimatter se zyada matter ban sakta hai. Masla abhi tak raaz hai.

Dark matter aur dark energy: Hum kainaat ke sirf taqreeban 5% ko jaante hain. Taqreeban 27% na-maloom maadda dark matter aur taqreeban 68% pur-asraar antigravity cheez dark energy hai; 27% + 68% = 95% hamare liye na-maloom hai.

Plasma: Maloom maadde ka taqreeban sara hissa hydrogen aur helium hai, aur yeh taqreeban poore plasma haalat mein hain. Is liye qabil-e-mushahida kainaat ka zyada tar maadda plasma hai.

book_ref.quote: Many observations show that there is the asymmetry between matter and antimatter.

blocks.prompt:
26 If 1.0 g of matter met 1.0 g of antimatter and both were completely annihilated, how much energy would be released? Use E = mc² with c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. (3 marks)
(Agar 1.0 g maadda 1.0 g antimatter se mile aur dono poori tarah annihilate ho jayen to kitni energy niklegi? E = mc² aur c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ lein.)
blocks.explanation: Annihilation mein dono (matter aur antimatter) ka poora mass energy ban jata hai; pehle grams ko kg mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: there are no any contribution of antihydrogen or anti-helium atoms

steps: Kul mass: m = 1.0 g + 1.0 g = 2.0 × 10⁻³ kg

blocks.prompt:
27 Describe the quantum field theory and the string theory of the forces between particles. What is the standard model? Describe its three categories of particles and its limitations. (5 marks)
(Particles ke darmiyan forces ki quantum field theory aur string theory bayan karein. Standard model kya hai? Is ke particles ki teen qismein aur is ki kamiyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Do theories mukhtalif mediators ke zariye particles ke ta'amul ko samjhati hain.

(i) Quantum field theory: Har particle aik quantum field se zahir hota hai jo mediator ke zariye aik particle se doosre tak force pohnchata hai. Maslan positive charge apne gird electric field banata hai aur us ke zariye qareebi negative charge ko kheenchta hai. Field energy aur momentum le jata hai jo quantized hain. Tabadla hone wale quanta field particles hain, sab bosons:
electromagnetic force: photons; strong nuclear force: gluons; weak force: W aur Z bosons; gravitational force: gravitons.

(ii) String theory: Bunyadi particles nuqte nahi balke nanhe thartharate strings hain, khule ya band loops. Un ki tharthrahat particle ki khususiyaat, mass aur force samet, tay karti hai. Yeh mumkina theory of everything hai magar tajurbe se abhi sabit nahi.

Standard model: theories ka majmua jo sab se chhote tajurbati taur par dekhe gaye particles aur energy-maadde ke ta'amul ko bayan karta hai. Particles ki teen qismein (Fig. 12.8):
Quarks aur leptons: maadda banate hain (kainaat ka sirf 5%).
Fundamental bosons: teen forces dete hain, electromagnetism, strong nuclear force aur weak nuclear force.
Higgs boson (2012 mein daryaft): batata hai ke doosre particles mass kaise paate hain.

Kamiyan: Model abhi na-mukammal hai. Yeh wazeh nahi kar sakta: (i) gravity (ii) dark matter (kainaat ka 27%) (iii) dark energy (kainaat ka 68%).

book_ref.quote: The standard model is the collection of theories that describe the smallest experimentally observed particles
